FIH Pro League 2025-26 |
February 11 | India vs Belgium
All the key moments from India’s clash against Belgium in the FIH Pro League 2025-26, as the visitors staged a strong second-half comeback to win 3-1 at the Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium in Rourkela, Odisha.
Shilanand Lakra’s equalizer sparked hope for India, but Belgium stepped up after the break, controlling possession and converting their chances to seal the game. From sharp saves to clinical finishes, it was an evening of high-quality international hockey with plenty of positives for the home side.
